title: Interest Terms on Security Deposits and the Commission Rate Table
content:
Interest on Security Deposits is earned on cash deposits only, at annual simple rates set for each calendar year by the state public service commission. The terms below are the interest terms of each tier.

## Tier terms

| Tier | Cash deposit earns interest | Days in the year used to prorate | Interest method | Payout of the prior year's interest | Bill month carrying the prior year's interest | Part-year interest up to a refund or application |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential Standard Deposit | yes | 365 | simple | bill credit | 1 (January) | yes |
| Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit | yes | 365 | simple | bill credit | 1 (January) | yes |
| Seasonal Residence Deposit | yes | 365 | simple | bill credit | 1 (January) | yes |
| Farm Service Deposit | yes | 365 | simple | bill credit | 1 (January) | yes |
| General Service Deposit | yes | 365 | simple | bill credit | 1 (January) | yes |
| Irrigation and Large Power Deposit | no | 365 | simple | bill credit | 1 (January) | yes |

Simple interest means interest never earns interest.

## Commission rate table (annual simple rate, percent)

Every tier's interest table carries the same commission rates:

| Calendar year | 2022 | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 | 2026 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Annual rate | 0.48 | 1.65 | 2.28 | 2.07 | 1.84 |

## Reading the terms

- The Irrigation and Large Power Deposit carries the same rate table, but its cash deposits do not earn interest.
- The interest day count is the divisor of the proration: interest for a span of days is the annual amount multiplied by those days and divided by 365.
- Hypothetical illustration: $400.00 held for 100 days of 2025 at 2.07 percent comes to $400.00 multiplied by 2.07 percent, multiplied by 100 and divided by 365, which is $2.27 to the cent.
